name: marin-front
title: Marin · front
note: Full-body A-pose. Use this as the main Marin input; the other views guide her likeness.

name: marin-profile
title: Marin · profile
note: Side silhouette, bob haircut, suit, gloves and boots.

name: marin-back
title: Marin · back
note: Rear suit and hair details. Backpack is a separate asset.

name: marin-face-closeups
title: Marin · face close-ups
note: Front, three-quarter and profile. Guide for likeness; do not use as the sole full-body input.

name: ant-worker-primary
title: Worker · single view
note: Compact dark worker. Reuse the same model for carrying, throwing and a folded-leg defeated pose.

name: ant-worker-sheet
title: Worker · turnaround
note: Body, profile, rear and head detail. Use to check the generated creature from multiple angles.

name: ant-soldier-primary
title: Soldier · single view
note: Large terracotta soldier with a broad rideable back and powerful mandibles.

name: ant-soldier-sheet
title: Soldier · turnaround
note: Body, profile, rear and head detail. Use to check the generated creature from multiple angles.

name: ant-flyer-primary
title: Flyer · single view
note: Four translucent wings and six legs. Wings should be separate animated parts.

name: ant-flyer-sheet
title: Flyer · turnaround
note: Body, profile, rear and head detail. Use to check the generated creature from multiple angles.

name: ant-queen-primary
title: Queen · single view
note: The queen always wears her visible gold crown during battle. Keep it as a separate attached part so it can fall only when she is defeated. Eyes glow crimson red; preserve their compound-eye texture. Use a separate red emissive eye material.

name: ant-queen-sheet
title: Queen · turnaround
note: The same prominent gold crown is visible in every view: front, profile, rear and facial close-up. Keep the crown attached until the queen is defeated. Eyes glow crimson red; preserve their compound-eye texture. Use a separate red emissive eye material.

name: gear-sprayer-primary
title: Backpack & sprayer
note: Shared base design for spray, foam and mist. Model the backpack, hose and wand as separate parts for animation.

name: gear-ant-cannon-primary
title: Ant cannon
note: Wide barrel and empty hopper. Keep the hopper lid movable; carried ammo is a separate game object.

name: prop-bait-trap-primary
title: Bait trap
note: A compact lure puck. Marin carries one and replenishes it at a refill station.

name: prop-refill-station-primary
title: Refill station
note: Open supply case with three fluid cartridges and one bait dock. Use the standalone trap design for its removable bait.

name: prop-queen-crown-primary
title: The queen’s crown
note: Separate wearable attachment: queen → falling pickup → Marin’s victory outfit.

name: prop-ant-egg-primary
title: Throwable ant egg
note: A single egg model can be repeated in clutches, collected and thrown.

name: environment-root-arch-primary
title: Nest root arch
note: Reusable underground scenery with amber resin and pale green fungi.
